name: Etix Cali #1
notes: Tier IV colocation data center in Zonamerica/Jamundi near Cali. Invest Pacific reported ground-breaking and full build-out of 840 kVA/240 racks; Invest in Colombia describes the Etix Cali, Valle del Cauca facility as Tier IV with IXP infrastructure; DataCenterMap lists 0.9 MW but marks the listing archived, so current commercial status should be rechecked.

name: Cirion CAL1
notes: Colocation data center at Av. 6b Nte. #25A-19, Cali, Valle. DataCenterMap lists the facility as operated by Cirion, formerly part of Lumen's Latin America operations, with owned building, 24/7 surveillance, biometric/card access, redundant resources, AC/DC power, and customer mini-racks/racks/cages/dedicated rooms.

name: Net Group S.A Cali Data Center
notes: Tier 3 data center and cloud/colocation provider at Cra 3 12 40 piso 6, Cali, Valle. DataCenterMap lists suites, cages, footprints, private/partial cabinets, individual servers, remote hands, bare metal, and public cloud services.

name: Tayra / BIOS supercomputer data center
notes: Government project to convert the underused Tayra data center at Colombia's Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Center (BIOS) in Valle del Cauca into the country's most powerful supercomputer. DCD reported COP 1.5bn investment and upgrade to 130 teraflops.

name: Colombian Navy base Puerto Carreno data center maintenance
developer: Armada Nacional de Colombia / JABO & CIA S.A.S.
notes: Weak but direct contractor evidence: JABO & CIA S.A.S. portfolio/search snippet describes maintenance of the data center, precision A/C, fire network, access controls, and automation at the Colombian Navy base in Puerto Carreno, Vichada. Treat as an institutional facility/maintenance project, not commercial colocation or hyperscale.
